about_zh: 操作系统层面的工具：桌面应用、菜单栏、窗口与文件管理。

repos.description: Turn any website into a lightweight desktop app with one command, on macOS, Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Pake 是一款基于 Rust Tauri 的轻量级桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网页转化为独立原生应用。相比 Electron 应用体积缩小约 20 倍，仅 5MB 左右，内存占用更低且运行更快。支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 三大平台，提供 CLI 命令行一键打包和在线构建服务。内置快捷键、沉浸式窗口、样式定制、广告过滤等功能，已预打包微信读书、Twitter、Grok、DeepSeek 等常用应用。
repos.summary_en: Pake is a lightweight desktop app packaging tool built with Rust Tauri that converts any webpage into a native standalone application. It reduces package size by approximately 20x compared to Electron (around 5MB), with faster performance and lower memory usage. Supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux, it offers one-command packaging via CLI and online building. Features include keyboard shortcuts, immersive windows, style customization, and ad removal. Pre-built packages are available for popular services like WeRead, Twitter, Grok, and DeepSeek.

repos.description: OCR software, free and offline. 开源、免费的离线OCR软件。支持截屏/批量导入图片，PDF文档识别，排除水印/页眉页脚，扫描/生成二维码。内置多国语言库。
repos.summary_zh: Umi-OCR 是一款开源、免费的离线 OCR 软件，支持 Windows 和 Linux 系统。核心功能包括截屏识别、批量图片/PDF 文档处理、二维码识别与生成，以及公式识别。其技术亮点在于内置高效离线引擎（支持 Rapid-OCR 和 PaddleOCR），提供排版解析和文本后处理（如排除水印/页眉页脚），并支持命令行与 HTTP 接口调用，满足高效、隐私安全的本地化文字识别需求。
repos.summary_en: Umi-OCR is a free, open-source offline OCR software for Windows and Linux. It offers screenshot OCR, batch image/PDF processing, QR code recognition/generation, and formula recognition. Key technical features include a built-in high-efficiency offline engine (supporting Rapid-OCR and PaddleOCR), layout analysis and text post-processing (e.g., excluding watermarks/headers/footers), and support for CLI and HTTP API integration, meeting the needs for efficient, privacy-preserving local text recognition.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

repos.description: Virtual machines for iOS and macOS
repos.summary_zh: UTM 是一款基于 QEMU 的 iOS 和 macOS 全系统虚拟化工具，支持 x86_64、ARM64、RISC-V 等 30 多种处理器架构。它提供 JIT 加速版本和无需越狱的 SE 解释器版本，可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上运行 Windows、Linux 等操作系统。利用 Hypervisor 和 Virtualization 框架实现硬件加速，是移动设备和桌面端的强大虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UTM is a full-featured system emulator and virtual machine host for iOS and macOS, built on QEMU. It supports 30+ processor architectures including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V, enabling users to run Windows, Linux, and other operating systems on iPhones, iPads, and Macs. The platform offers JIT-based acceleration for optimal performance and a special SE (Slow Edition) using threaded interpretation that requires no jailbreak. With native frontends leveraging latest Apple APIs and hardware acceleration via Hypervisor.framework and Virtualization.framework, UTM delivers a powerful cross-platform virtualization solution for both mobile and desktop environments.

repos.description: A Programmer’s Guide to Longevity | Helping everyone live a longer, healthier, happier life. Available in 8 languages.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为程序员设计，基于全因死亡率（ACM）学术证据，提供量化延寿策略。核心通过优化饮食（如蔬果、坚果摄入降低27% ACM）、运动（挥拍运动降47% ACM）及生活习惯（7小时睡眠），目标降低66.67% ACM并增加20年预期寿命。亮点在于结构化输入-输出框架及争议数据处理，直击久坐职业健康痛点。
repos.summary_en: Tailored for programmers, this guide leverages all-cause mortality (ACM) research to deliver quantified longevity strategies. Key actions include dietary optimization (e.g., fruits/nuts reducing ACM by 27%), racket sports (47% ACM reduction), and sleep management (7-hour optimum), targeting 66.67% ACM decrease and ~20-year lifespan gain. Unique for its input-output framework and evidence-based controversy analysis, addressing sedentary occupational health risks.

repos.description: An evolving how-to guide for securing a Linux server.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供全面的 Linux 服务器安全加固实践指南，涵盖 SSH 密钥与 2FA 认证、UFW 防火墙配置、Fail2Ban/CrowdSec 入侵防御、AIDE 文件完整性监控等核心模块。通过 Ansible Playbooks 实现自动化部署，结合纵深防御理念，为系统管理员和 DevOps 提供从基础加固到持续审计的一站式安全解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a comprehensive, continuously updated guide for Linux server security hardening with actionable implementations. It systematically covers SSH hardening with key-based authentication and two-factor authentication, network security via UFW firewall and PSAD intrusion detection, application-layer protection using Fail2Ban and CrowdSec, and continuous monitoring through AIDE file integrity checks, Lynis auditing, and OSSEC HIDS. The guide emphasizes defense-in-depth strategies and provides production-ready Ansible Playbooks for automated deployment, making it an essential resource for system administrators, DevOps engineers, and security professionals seeking to implement robust server security from fundamentals to advanced threat detection.

repos.description: Open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array RADAR system
repos.summary_zh: AERIS-10是一款开源低成本10.5GHz相控阵雷达系统，提供3km和20km两种探测距离版本。系统采用脉冲线性调频(PLFM)技术，支持±45°电子波束扫描，集成FPGA实现脉冲压缩、多普勒处理、MTI和CFAR等先进信号处理。模块化设计包含电源管理、频率合成和射频主板，搭载Python GUI地图界面和GPS/IMU实时校正。面向无人机开发、科研教育和雷达爱好者，提供完整的硬件原理图、PCB布局和开源软件，旨在降低相控阵雷达技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system with 3km and 20km range variants. It features Pulse Linear Frequency Modulation (PLFM) and ±45° electronic beam steering. The FPGA handles advanced signal processing including pulse compression, Doppler FFT, MTI, and CFAR. Its modular architecture comprises power management, frequency synthesis, and RF main boards, complemented by a Python GUI with map integration and GPS/IMU support. Designed for drone developers, researchers, and radar enthusiasts, it provides complete schematics and software to democratize phased array radar technology.

repos.description: macOS inside a Docker container.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过Docker容器化技术结合KVM硬件加速，在非Apple硬件上实现macOS虚拟化。提供Web管理界面，支持macOS 11-15版本自动部署与灵活资源配置（存储/CPU/内存）。适用于iOS/macOS应用开发测试、CI/CD流水线及跨平台开发环境，为开发者提供无需Apple硬件的macOS虚拟化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: This project enables macOS virtualization on non-Apple hardware through Docker containerization with KVM hardware acceleration. It features web-based management, automated deployment of macOS versions 11-15 (Big Sur to Sequoia), and flexible configuration of storage, CPU, and RAM resources. Supporting Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and GitHub Codespaces deployment, it is ideal for iOS/macOS app development testing, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-platform development environments, providing developers with a convenient, production-ready macOS virtualization solution without Apple hardware requirements.

repos.description: Dism++ Multi-language Support & BUG Report
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是Dism++的多语言本地化资源库，为这款Windows系统优化工具提供16种语言的翻译文件，涵盖应用界面与官方网站。包含Data.xml系统清理规则配置及崩溃统计后台，默认开发语言为简体中文，由全球译者协作维护各语言版本的质量与准确性。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts multilingual localization resources for Dism++, a Windows system optimization utility. It provides translation files for 16+ languages covering both the application interface and official website. The project includes Data.xml with system cleanup rules and a crash statistics backend. Default development language is Simplified Chinese, maintained through global translator collaboration to ensure localization quality across all language versions.

repos.description: A web client for its own Xray-based core with global transparent proxy on Linux, Windows and macOS.
repos.summary_zh: v2rayA 是一款基于 V2Ray 内核的跨平台代理客户端，提供直观的 Web 图形界面。支持 VMess、VLESS、SS、SSR、Trojan、Tuic 和 Juicity 等主流协议，可在 Linux 实现全局透明代理，Windows/macOS 支持系统代理。项目支持 Docker、路由器、NAS 等多种部署方式，所有用户数据本地存储，适合需要安全便捷网络访问的场景。
repos.summary_en: v2rayA is a cross-platform proxy client based on V2Ray core with an intuitive Web GUI. It supports major protocols including VMess, VLESS, SS, SSR, Trojan, Tuic and Juicity, offering global transparent proxy on Linux and system proxy on Windows/macOS. Deployable via Docker, routers, NAS and multiple package managers, it stores all user data locally, ideal for secure and convenient network access.

repos.description: 📻Free and open-sourced terminal/ssh/sftp/ftp/telnet/serialport/RDP/VNC/Spice client(Linux, Mac, Windows, Android, HarmonyOS, iOS)
repos.summary_zh: electerm 是一款开源的跨平台终端与远程连接客户端，集成 SSH/SFTP/FTP/Telnet/串口/RDP/VNC 等多种协议。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux（含 ARM64），提供全局热键、透明窗口、背景图片等特性。内置 AI 助手（DeepSeek/OpenAI）与 MCP 协议支持，实现命令建议与工具集成。通过 Zmodem/Trzsz 实现文件传输，并可将配置同步至 GitHub/Gitee Gist，是开发者管理远程服务器的全能工具。
repos.summary_en: electerm is an open-source, cross-platform terminal and remote connection client that consolidates SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC, and Spice protocols into a single application. Built on Electron, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux (including ARM64 architectures). Key features include global hotkeys for instant access, transparent windows, terminal background images, and integrated AI assistants (DeepSeek, OpenAI) via MCP protocol for command suggestions and script generation. It facilitates file transfers through Zmodem and Trzsz, supports SSH tunneling and proxy configurations, and allows synchronization of bookmarks and settings to GitHub/Gitee Gist, making it a versatile tool for developers and system administrators managing remote infrastructure.

repos.description: 一键DD/重装脚本 (One-click reinstall OS on VPS)
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本为 VPS 提供一键重装解决方案，支持 19 种 Linux 发行版与 Windows 官方原版 ISO 互转。采用分区表 ID 识别硬盘确保操作安全，智能配置动静态网络适配 /32、纯 IPv6 等特殊环境，内存占用低于官方 netboot，兼容 BIOS/EFI 及 ARM 架构，所有资源实时从官方源获取。
repos.summary_en: This script provides a one-click OS reinstall solution for VPS, supporting 19 Linux distributions and Windows official ISO cross-installation between Linux and Windows systems. It uses partition table ID to identify disks ensuring operation safety, intelligently configures static/dynamic networking for special environments like /32, pure IPv6, and IPv4/IPv6 on different NICs. Optimized for low-resource VPS with minimal memory footprint, it supports BIOS/EFI and ARM architectures, sourcing all resources directly from official mirrors in real-time without custom packages.

repos.description: AutoHotkey - macro-creation and automation-oriented scripting utility for Windows.
repos.summary_zh: AutoHotkey是Windows平台开源自动化脚本工具，专注于宏创建与重复任务自动化。采用自定义脚本语言，提供强大的热键定义、快捷键重映射及GUI自动化能力。基于C++开发，支持Visual Studio编译，兼容Unicode/ANSI。v2版本持续更新，v1由社区维护，支持Windows XP至11系统，是提升工作效率的利器。
repos.summary_en: AutoHotkey is a powerful open-source automation scripting tool for Windows, specializing in macro creation and repetitive task automation. It features a custom scripting language with robust hotkey definition capabilities, enabling keyboard shortcut remapping, automated operations, and GUI scripting. Developed in C++, it supports compilation via Visual Studio and VS Code, with Unicode/ANSI compatibility. The actively maintained v2 branch coexists with community-supported v1, supporting Windows XP through 11. It's an essential utility for enhancing productivity through automation.

repos.description: 📱 Display and control your Android device graphically with scrcpy.
repos.summary_zh: Escrcpy 是基于 scrcpy 的跨平台 Android 设备图形化管控工具。通过 Electron 封装提供直观界面，支持多设备并行管理与可视化窗口编排。核心亮点包括集成 AutoGLM 实现自然语言智能控制、自动化工作流执行，以及 Gnirehtet 反向网络共享。适用于移动开发测试、批量设备操作等场景，提供低延迟、高性能的屏幕镜像体验。
repos.summary_en: Escrcpy is a cross-platform Android device management tool built on scrcpy. It provides an intuitive Electron-based GUI for mirroring and controlling Android devices with low latency. Key features include multi-device orchestration, natural language control via AutoGLM AI, automated workflow execution, and wireless connectivity with Gnirehtet reverse tethering. Ideal for mobile development, testing, and batch device operations.

repos.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
repos.summary_zh: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

repos.description: Supports running Armbian on Amlogic, Allwinner, and Rockchip devices. Support a311d, s922x, s905x3, s905x2, s912, s905d, s905x, s905w, s905, s905l, rk3588, rk3568, rk3399, rk3328, h6, etc.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目将Armbian轻量级Linux系统移植到Amlogic、Rockchip和Allwinner等电视盒子及ARM开发板，支持s922x、s905x3、rk3588等多款芯片。用户可替换Android TV系统，将盒子转为基于Debian/Ubuntu的服务器，支持eMMC写入、内核更新与SSH远程管理。适用于家庭服务器、开发测试、NAS及媒体中心等场景，提供Docker镜像与详细文档，助力消费级设备变身高性能Linux机器。
repos.summary_en: This project ports the Armbian lightweight Linux distribution to TV boxes and ARM single-board computers based on Amlogic, Rockchip, and Allwinner SoCs such as s922x, s905x3, rk3588, and more. It enables users to replace Android TV with a full Debian/Ubuntu-based server operating system, featuring eMMC installation, kernel updates, and SSH remote management capabilities. Ideal for home servers, development platforms, NAS, and media centers, the project provides Docker images and comprehensive documentation to transform consumer devices into powerful, stable Linux machines for various server applications.

repos.description: A free, open-source Windows desktop organizer with native-feeling WinUI 3 widgets.
repos.summary_zh: DeskBox是一款免费开源的Windows桌面整理工具，基于WinUI 3和.NET 10 Native AOT构建，提供原生质感的桌面小组件，支持文件整理、待办、搜索、天气和音乐控制等。它采用本地优先存储，不改变现有文件结构，支持Mica和Acrylic材质，兼容x64和ARM64，提供13种语言界面，是Stardock Fences的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: DeskBox is a free, open-source Windows desktop organizer built with WinUI 3 and .NET 10 Native AOT, offering native-feeling desktop widgets for file organization, todos, search, weather, and music controls. It is local-first, preserves existing file structures, supports Mica and Acrylic materials, works on x64 and ARM64, and provides 13 languages, serving as an open-source alternative to Stardock Fences.

repos.description: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
repos.summary_zh: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
repos.summary_en: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

repos.description: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
repos.summary_zh: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
repos.summary_en: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
repos.summary_en: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

repos.description: The Librum client application
repos.summary_zh: Librum 是一款基于 Qt 框架构建的开源跨平台电子书阅读与管理应用，核心价值在于融合个人数字图书馆与云同步能力。支持 EPUB 等格式，提供笔记、高亮、AI 辅助工具及深度界面定制，可自托管实现多设备无缝访问。集成 70,000+ 免费书籍资源，以现代化交互设计和隐私优先架构，为追求个性化与可控性的数字阅读者提供一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Librum is an open-source, cross-platform e-book reader built on Qt framework that merges personal digital library management with cloud synchronization. It offers note-taking, highlighting, AI-powered tools, and deep UI customization, supporting self-hosting for multi-device access. Featuring 70,000+ free books and a modern interface, it delivers a privacy-focused, all-in-one reading solution for users seeking personalized digital literacy experiences.

repos.description: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
repos.summary_zh: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
repos.summary_en: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

repos.description: A translation-based Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs
repos.summary_zh: Stela 是面向 x86-64 PC 的通用 Apple Silicon 层，通过 UEFI 启动，集成 arm64-to-x86-64 翻译器（覆盖 3000+ 指令）、NVIDIA Metal 驱动（AIR 转 NIR）和 Apple silicon 硬件模型，使 macOS 27 能在 Intel/AMD 机器上运行。目前开发中，速度较慢。
repos.summary_en: Stela is a general-purpose Apple Silicon layer for x86-64 PCs. It boots via UEFI, integrating an arm64-to-x86-64 translator (covering 3000+ instructions), a Metal driver for NVIDIA GPUs (AIR to NIR), and an Apple silicon hardware model, enabling macOS 27 to run on Intel/AMD machines. Currently in development, it is slow.

repos.description: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
repos.summary_en: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!
repos.summary_zh: 通过 MCP 协议将 Grok 实时搜索能力集成至 Claude，突破模型知识截止限制。基于 FastMCP 构建，提供 AI 优化的结构化搜索结果，支持多平台过滤与网页抓取。可一键禁用官方工具并强制路由，实现无缝即插即用。适用于事实核查、实时信息检索与研究分析场景，显著增强 AI 的时效性信息获取能力。
repos.summary_en: Integrates Grok's real-time search capabilities into Claude via MCP protocol, effectively breaking through the model's knowledge cutoff limitation. Built on FastMCP framework, it delivers AI-optimized structured search results with multi-platform filtering and web scraping support. Features one-click disabling of native tools with forced routing for seamless plug-and-play experience. Includes automatic time injection and dynamic model switching capabilities. Ideal for fact-checking, real-time information retrieval, and research analysis scenarios, significantly enhancing AI's ability to access up-to-date information and verify facts with current data.

repos.description: Premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagram Codex skill
repos.summary_zh: 该Codex技能通过JSON规范生成高端手绘动态架构图，支持输出可编辑Excalidraw文件、PNG静态预览及真实动画GIF，包含流动高光、模块脉冲等效果。采用Python Pillow本地渲染，无需浏览器或外部API，专为技术文章、系统架构和流程图设计，提供专业黑背景可视化方案，内置帧差验证确保动画质量。
repos.summary_en: This Codex skill generates premium hand-drawn animated architecture diagrams from JSON specs, producing editable Excalidraw files, PNG previews, and genuinely animated GIFs with moving glow points and pulsing modules on a dark canvas. It uses local Python Pillow rendering with no external dependencies, ideal for technical articles, system architectures, and workflows, including built-in frame-diff verification for motion.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: A tiny hand on a stick that points at things on your Mac screen.
repos.summary_zh: TinyHand 是一款 macOS 屏幕指针工具，在屏幕上显示一只小手或激光点，用于演示、录屏或远程指导时精准指向内容。支持点击、拖动画线、添加箭头、36种手势及声音反馈，可通过菜单栏快捷键或 tinyhand:// URL 自动化控制，轻量且开源。
repos.summary_en: TinyHand is a macOS on-screen pointer tool that displays a tiny hand or laser dot to precisely point at content during demos, recordings, or remote guidance. It supports clicking, drag-drawing, arrowheads, 36 hand styles, and tap sounds, controllable via menu bar shortcuts or tinyhand:// URLs. Lightweight and open-source.

repos.description: Use your android phone as windows virtual webcam
repos.summary_zh: VCamdroid 将 Android 手机摄像头转化为 Windows 高性能虚拟摄像头。通过 Softcam 的 DirectShow 滤镜实现与 Zoom、OBS、Teams 等应用的无缝兼容，支持 ADB 有线和 Wi-Fi 无线连接，采用 RTSP 协议、Camera2 API、OpenGL 预处理及硬件编码（H.264/HEVC），提供低延迟视频流。支持多设备切换、相机控制（前后摄、分辨率、闪光灯）及实时图像调整（旋转、翻转、亮度等），适用于视频会议、直播和录制场景。
repos.summary_en: VCamdroid turns your Android phone's camera into a high-performance virtual webcam for Windows. It uses a custom DirectShow filter from the Softcam library for seamless compatibility with Zoom, OBS, Discord, and Teams. Supporting both ADB wired and Wi-Fi wireless connections via RTSP, it delivers low-latency, hardware-accelerated streams using Camera2 API, OpenGL preprocessing, and MediaCodec encoding. Features include multi-device support, full camera controls, and real-time image adjustments, ideal for video calls, streaming, and recording.

repos.description: crate: run Linux VMs on iPhone and iPad
repos.summary_zh: crate是一款在iPhone和iPad上运行完整Linux发行版的虚拟机应用，完全在设备本地运行，无需远程连接或云端依赖。它采用Rust从零编写的arm64翻译引擎，性能远超QEMU TCG，支持Ubuntu、Debian和Arch Linux ARM，通过virglrenderer、ANGLE和MoltenVK实现GPU加速桌面，并针对触摸、键盘和折叠屏优化，让手机变成真正的Linux电脑，支持Claude Code等开发工具。
repos.summary_en: crate is a virtual machine app that runs full Linux distributions on iPhone and iPad, entirely on-device with no remote connection or cloud dependency. Powered by a Rust-based arm64 translation engine that outperforms QEMU TCG, it supports Ubuntu, Debian, and Arch Linux ARM with GPU-accelerated desktops via virglrenderer, ANGLE, and MoltenVK, and is optimized for touch, keyboard, and foldable screens, turning your phone into a real Linux computer that can run developer tools like Claude Code.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.description: Ubuntu 26.04 + Phosh for the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (diting, SM8475) on mainline Linux: build system, packages, kernel patches
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库将 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS 与 Phosh 移动桌面环境移植至小米 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra（骁龙8+ Gen 1），包含主线 Linux 内核补丁、完整构建系统、Debian 打包及音频/相机/视频解码等硬件适配，实现手机运行完整 Linux 桌面系统。
repos.summary_en: This repository ports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS with the Phosh mobile desktop environment to the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, SM8475). It provides mainline Linux kernel patches, a complete build system, Debian packaging, and hardware enablement for audio, camera, and video decoding (VA-API), enabling a full Linux desktop on a smartphone using upstream stable kernel with device-specific patches.

repos.description: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
repos.summary_zh: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
repos.summary_en: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.
